title: Source-only QNC/QNN producer and transport chain review

findings.fact: QNCCN/QNCLOUD are Registry scalar fields with unit label # kg(-1), scalar package membership, and Registry trait string i0rhusdf=(bdy_interp:dt). The ccn_conc rconfig is separately labeled # m-3 with default 1.0E8.
findings.scope: Registry declares metadata and scalar state behavior; it does not identify the denominator behind # kg(-1), nor whether qnc is grid-mean or in-cloud.

findings.fact: For the option-37 UDM package, qnc_curr is passed directly as NC to UDM and returned state remains in the same scalar array. No driver-side rho or cloud-fraction multiplier is applied at this call boundary. The qnc field is provided by Registry-managed scalar state (initial/restart/boundary data); no dedicated model-side QNC conversion initializer was found in the inspected chain.
findings.scope: This establishes pass-through at the UDM interface; it cannot identify how an external initial-condition producer intended QNC.

findings.fact: When the option-37 diagnosed-cloud-fraction path is enabled and itimestep==1, the driver fills the entire qnn_curr storage array with ccn_conc, with no rho/CF conversion, then passes ccn_preinitialized=.true.; UDM thereby skips its per-tile ccn0 initialization. ccn_conc is Registry-labeled # m-3. UDM initialization udminit receives ccn_conc as INTENT(IN) and does not transform it. The legacy UDM fallback likewise assigns ccn0 directly if used.
findings.scope: The implemented seed path places the configured volume-unit scalar directly in a field declared # kg(-1). This is a source-level interface inconsistency; it does not determine which unit label or initializer convention is the intended contract.

findings.fact: QNC/QNN are in the generic 3-D scalar advance. rk_scalar_tend calls the configured scalar advection and mixing routines; rk_update_scalar advances the value using ((c1*mu_old+c2)*scalar_old + dt*tendency)/(c1*mu_new+c2). The code comments that scalar tendencies are coupled with mu. There is no QNC/QNN-specific conversion by rho in this generic advance.
findings.scope: The transport equation conserves scalar-times-dry-mass-coordinate (mu) under the WRF scalar formulation. This supports a per-dry-mass transported interpretation, but does not establish the upstream producer definition or repair the QNN volume-unit seed.

findings.fact: For specified-boundary handling, P_QNN receives the dedicated flow_dep_bdy_qnn routine; inflow assigns ccn_conc directly, and outflow copies an interior scalar. QNC follows the generic scalar boundary path. Registry trait strings include restart handling for both state scalars. No field-specific conversion was found in the restart or boundary path inspected.
findings.scope: Boundary behavior repeats the QNN seed mismatch; generic Registry restart preserves values but adds no physical unit conversion.

findings.fact: Driver passes rho and input_density_is_dry=.true. UDM uses the supplied density as its dry-density value and copies qnn/qnc into internal number arrays without a boundary conversion. Cloud slope calculation is source expression lambda=(pidnc*Nc/(qc*rho))^(1/3), with pidnc=pi*rho_water/6.
findings.scope: Density is explicitly classified as dry, but no source declaration states the unit/basis of the incoming Nc or whether Nc is grid-mean or in-cloud. The slope expression is dimensionally consistent with a volumetric Nc interpretation; this is a diagnostic source observation, not proof of intended producer semantics.

closed: The Registry declares QNC/QNN as # kg(-1).
The option-37 QNN cold-start and specified-inflow seed paths copy ccn_conc directly; ccn_conc is declared # m-3.
Generic scalar RK transport weights the scalar by mu and applies no QNC/QNN-specific rho conversion.
The UDM driver explicitly marks its density argument dry and passes QNC/QNN arrays without a unit conversion at that interface.
open: Whether the # kg(-1) Registry labels are intended as per kg dry air, per kg moist air, or are stale for these fields.
Whether ccn_conc is intended to be converted to a mass-specific value before QNN initialization/boundary assignment, or whether the field’s intended representation is actually volumetric.
Whether QNC is grid-mean or in-cloud at initialization, advection, cloud-fraction processing, activation, sedimentation, and radiation-radius use.
The authoritative producer/initial-condition contract for QNC and QNN, including restart/real-data generation.
contract_result.decision: Do not close the unit contract or choose a rho/CF correction from these findings alone. The source chain proves a direct mismatch between declared QNN units and the configured QNN seed value, while exposing no authoritative intended-value definition.

next_contract: Obtain or write the authoritative initialization contract for ccn_conc and input QNC/QNN, including whether each is # m-3 or # kg_dry-1 and whether it is grid-mean or in-cloud.

Require one consistent declared representation at initialization, boundary inflow, restart, dynamics transport, UDM process entry, and diagnostic output. If a conversion is intended, name its exact density (dry versus moist) and its precise interface.

Only after the contract is approved, use source-extracted tests at two dry densities to verify the agreed conversion is applied once at each relevant boundary and never compounded; use inactive/partial/full CF and below/partial/capped RH cases to separate cloud-fraction and activation behavior.
Keep radiation PSD population/LUT interpretation as a separate unresolved contract.
limitations: No compilation, model, solver, runtime log, NetCDF/raw state, or scientific numeric array was read or produced.
Source paths/line ranges and hashes refer to the frozen PR146 source checkout identified above.
